profile.name: 多比特量子控制与读出系统
profile.name_en: Multi-qubit Quantum Control and Readout System
profile.description: 用于超导量子比特实验的组合式电子测控系统，协同任意波形发生器、数字时序控制器、通量控制链路和积分采集读出设备，对多个量子比特进行时序对齐、通量脉冲控制与读出测量。常用于时域实验、单次读出、相关性测量和系统标定。
profile.description_en: A composite electronic control and measurement system for superconducting qubit experiments. It coordinates waveform generators, digital timing controllers, flux-control lines, and integrated readout hardware to align timing, apply flux pulses, and perform qubit readout across multiple qubits. It is commonly used for time-domain experiments, single-shot readout, correlation measurements, and calibration.

registry.name: QuTech HAL_Shim MQ
registry.description: HAL Shim MQ是由QuTech生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括日志记录、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, get correlation detector等操作。
